name: Absalom Local
text: You've made the Lorespire Complex your home and are immersed in the culture of Absalom Station. While most Starfinders can't wait to leave the station, you've developed a deep appreciation of its culture and history.

name: Acolyte
text: You've joined the Xenowardens because you care deeply about nature and conserving natural resources. You find ways to connect with nature in even the most urban environments.

name: Acquisitive
text: While most Starfinders joined the Society for a chance to explore the galaxy or uncover ancient history, you joined for far more practical reasons: wealth and influence.

name: Advocate
text: You love being a member of the Starfinder Society, and deeply cherish the bonds you've formed with your fellow Starfinders. Inspired by these bonds, your moral compass, a sense of justice, or perhaps fellow Starfinder Zigvigix's public effort, you advocate for the betterment of all Starfinders. Sometimes this means lobbying to improve work conditions and support systems, sometimes this means volunteering your time to causes and services you believe make a positive impact, and sometimes this means healing wounds, assisting with recovery, or offering a compassionate shoulder to lean on to a Starfinder in need. Choose one: Diplomacy (No Cause for Alarm), Medicine (Battle Medicine).

name: Akashic Recorder
text: Your mind is mystically linked to the Akashic Record, an astral repository of all knowledge and memory. You might be a member of the Akashic Society.

name: Akitonian Explorer
text: You've been to the planet Akiton before, perhaps for a vacation, to visit a friend, through your work with the Starfinder Society, or because it's your home world.

name: Alien Hunter
text: You explored the Xenowardens starship Bloom and teamed up with a ghost to destroy Sample 62, a vicious alien monster that killed the starship's crew.

name: Ancient Elebrian
text: You're an ancient resident of Eox. You might have survived in magitech stasis deep inside a ruined necropolis, or you might serve as the trusted, long-dead servant of a bone sage.

name: Anomaly Hunter
text: You're a paranormal investigator on the trail of a cosmic mystery, cryptid, or conspiracy. You might investigate the effects of the Newborn hatching on Absalom Station.

name: Antediluvian Seeker
text: You're fascinated by artifacts that originate from bygone eras, and you've even learned to craft functional replicas of them. You might be a member of the Antiquarian Lodge.

name: Arena Veteran
text: Some say the red sands of Akiton get their color from the blood spilled in the arenas of Arl, and you've spilled your share as a gladiator.

name: Artist
text: Your art is your greatest passion, whatever form it takes. Adventuring might help you find inspiration for your creations, or simply be a way to fund them.

name: Athlete
text: You've strengthened your body through practice drills and workouts, making sure not to waste a single drop of sweat in your quest for gains.

name: Bartender
text: Every city in the galaxy has something in common—there's always a bar. And behind that bar, there's usually someone like you, ready to pour drinks and listen to troubles.

name: Bouncer
text: You know how to leverage your powerful physique to earn a paycheck. You might guard a bank, a glitzy night club, or a seedy dive bar.

name: Bounty Hunter
text: You hunt people down for credits. You might work with a corporation, military, or some other organization.

name: Brutaris Player
text: The sound of a roaring crowd still sends your heart pumping as you recall your glory days as a brutaris player, whether you retired successfully or were forced out.

name: Busker
text: You're a street performer in a busy spaceport. You might serenade passersby with music or create street art, or perhaps you use elaborate costumes and acrobatics.

name: Chatty
text: You're a social butterfly on the infosphere. You've met people from all over the galaxy, and your virtual identity is just as important to you as your physical one.

name: Chevalier
text: You live by a code of chivalry and participate in the traditions of ancient cultures. You might have ties to Lost Golarion through your heritage, or simply adopted the code.

name: City Slicker
text: You've lived long enough in a major settlement to know how to keep your head down, avoid direct eye contact, and otherwise move about your day without drawing attention.

name: Clansworn
text: You're a member of a dwarven clan or one of their retainers, and your clan's allegiance lies with Ulrikka Clanholdings.

name: Cleaner
text: You know how to remove all traces of a crime. Whether you worked under the table for legitimate clients or learned your trade in the criminal underground.

name: Cloud Chemist
text: You've studied the properties and chemical applications of the complex array of gases available on gas giants like Bretheda and Liavara.

name: Code Carrier
text: You or one of your personal tech items was infected with a harmless but annoying tech virus. You've learned to ignore its effects and even transmit it to others.

name: Comedian
text: Whether you're the office joker, a professional comedian, or just a troll on the infosphere, you're always prepared with a well-timed joke.

name: Consultant
text: You're a corporate consultant who's been hired for your expertise in the field. You might be a former employee of Ulrikka Clanholdings or someone with specialized knowledge.

name: Cook
text: You grew up in the kitchens of a tavern or other dining establishment and excelled there, becoming an exceptional chef with a gift for feeding the hungry.

name: Corporate Agent
text: You're one among many professionals working in the corporate world—a negotiator, dealmaker, or perhaps even a spy advancing your company's agenda.

name: Courier
text: You know your city or space station like the back of your hand, and nothing stops you from getting cargo to its destination on time.

name: Crystal Prospector
text: You've worked in a mine harvesting cerebinium crystals, shimmerstone, or some other magical mineral found deep in the earth or in asteroids.

name: Crèche Born
text: You were born in one of the crèche worlds of the Diaspora, magically maintained bubble ecosystems that flourish on hidden asteroids far from civilization.

name: Cult Escapee
text: While you don't like to talk about it, you have a connection to one of the most dangerous cults in the Universe: the cult of the Devourer. Perhaps you used to be a member of this nihilistic religious cult, a close friend or family member joined their ranks, or you were once a victim of their predations. Whatever the connection, you slipped away and have been laying low ever since.

name: Cyberborn
text: Your body is a temple to change and technology. Since a young age, you've been upgrading your anatomy with augmentations, perhaps after a terrible accident or by choice.

name: Daegox Convict
text: You or your parents were sentenced to live on the corporate prison planet Daegox-4. You might be a career criminal tired of serving time or a reformed person seeking a new life.

name: Dataphile
text: You spend a lot of time in the Archives' Cortex, studying or maintaining the digital database that contains records of all the Starfinder Society's expeditions.

name: Defector
text: You were an imperial trooper until you had a change of heart for one reason or another. You've given up your rank and perhaps allied with those who oppose your former masters.

name: Defiant Victor
text: You've heard time and time again that a Starfinder needs to be knowledgeable, skilled, and personable—traits you've never had in abundance. But you didn't let that stop you from becoming a Starfinder! You've got what you consider to be the most important trait of all: defiant persistence! You don't let naysayers, bigwigs, or your own personal failings stop you from achieving your goals, just like you don't let a little blood, sweat, or tears keep you down. You know when push comes to shove, you can take the hits, and just keep coming. Failure isn't in your vocabulary!

name: Detective
text: You solved crimes as a police inspector or took clandestine jobs for various clients as a private investigator.

name: Diplomat
text: You've dedicated your career to facilitating peaceful alliances between different factions and peoples. First contact situations are your specialty.

name: Disciple
text: You're a loyal disciple of a particular deity. You might have been raised in a religious culture or perhaps felt a kindred calling toward a god later in life.

name: Doctor
text: You're an accomplished healer expertly using the latest tech and pharmaceuticals to treat your patients. You might work at a clinic or supervise a medical bay on a starship.

name: Dream Prophet
text: A mysterious entity haunts your dreams, granting you a glimpse of transcendence. These supernatural experiences have inspired you to seek greater understanding of the universe.

name: Dreamer Disciple
text: You've communed with one of the Dreamers, the enlightened barathus singing unknowable songs on Liavara—and they revealed some cosmic truth to you.

name: Electrician
text: You know better than most the power of electricity, having survived several close calls yourself, and you know firsthand how shocking it can be.

name: Emissary
text: As a diplomat or messenger, you traveled extensively, communicating with new people and brokering alliances wherever you went.

name: Eoxian Local
text: You grew up on Eox or spent a significant amount of time there learning about the macabre customs and decadent culture of the grave world.

name: Escaped Experiment
text: You were the subject of an experiment. You might be a creature born in a laboratory, a failed super soldier prototype, or a recipient of odd modifications.

name: Escort
text: People hire you to accompany them in social situations. You might be a charming courtesan, burly bodyguard, skillful interpreter, or something else entirely.

name: Esoteric Erudite
text: You're fascinated with strange phenomena, occult rituals, dangerous magic, and planar beings. You've dedicated your life to unraveling these mysteries and studying the foul magic and dangerous creatures that are often related to them. Recently, you've spotted strange symbols written in blood around Absalom Station, which you believe might have a connection to fiends.

name: Exo-Guardian
text: You know the galaxy hides countless dangers, and you've trained hard to stand firm against these threats. You don't just want to be a Starfinder—you want to be its shield.

name: Fashionista
text: You're a clothing connoisseur. You might be a fashion designer, trendy socialite, or famous model. One thing is for sure—you've got style.

name: Final Survivor
text: You were the last survivor of a horrifying incident. You might be the last person left alive on a Swarm huskworld, or you might have survived a catastrophic accident.

name: First Ones Scholar
text: You've studied the First Ones extensively, poring over scientific journals and conspiracy theories alike, and have delved into the Starfinder Society's archives.

name: Fixer
text: It's not who you are, it's who you know—and you know a lot of people. They call you when they need a favor done, and you don't ask questions.

name: Forum Aspirant
text: You consider yourself an exemplary Starfinder, and you aim to one day join the Forum, the council of respected Starfinders that guides the Society.

name: Gambler
text: The thrill of the win drew you into games of chance. This might have been a lucrative pastime that paled in comparison to the real risks of adventuring.

name: Gambler
text: You play the hand you're dealt. You might be a high-rolling card shark, high-stakes risker, lucky winner, or cheater who's finally met their match in adventure.

name: Gene Splicer
text: You're an expert on biotech and genetics and frequently experiment on your own body. You might have worked with patients who needed gene therapy or enhancement.

name: Ghosted
text: When the Newborn's cry shook Absalom Station, you were pulled into the Ghost Levels. You eventually found your way out, or you were rescued, but the experience left its mark.

name: Grave Medic
text: You're a healer who doesn't keep people alive. Your specialty is treating undead patients. You might be undead yourself, or a compassionate ally of Eox.

name: Green Activist
text: You've joined the Xenowardens because you care deeply about nature and conserving natural resources. You find ways to connect with nature even in urban environments.

name: Grifter
text: You're a con artist and trickster who swindles unsuspecting dupes and blackmails rubes, but it's nothing personal—you're just in it for the credits.

name: Guidance's Favored
text: You communicate frequently with Guidance, the amalgam intelligence that advises the First Seeker, and even help maintain Guidance's servers.

name: Gun For Hire
text: You're a mercenary who rents your services to the highest bidder. You might pick up jobs at Absalom Station's Merc Lurk or hang around a dodgy Second Seekers contact.

name: Hacker
text: You've always had a knack for computers and virtual spaces and pride yourself on your ability to learn technical secrets through the infosphere.

name: Hacktivist
text: You're a hacker with a cause, which might be personal, political, or religious. Perhaps you're a member of an anonymous collective working toward a specific goal.

name: Haunted
text: You're haunted by a restless spirit. You might have performed a ritual or come into possession of an object that drew the spirit to you.

name: Hellforged Squire
text: You've forged yourself to join the ranks of the Hellknights, and completing this mission to the letter of the contract is your duty, thrice sworn and sealed.

name: Hero in the Making
text: You've always dreamed of being a hero—of fighting off nefarious villains, foiling sinister plots, and saving innocents from peril. In fact, you joined the Starfinder Society hoping to make this dream a reality. You've come to realize that while heroism is important, the events and situations that give rise to heroes are no laughing matter. Now, lives are on the line, and you're determined to stand your ground, fight the good fight, and protect the citizens of Absalom Station, no matter the dangers that come your way.

name: Hitchhiker
text: You've hitched a ride on a ship traveling across the galaxy. You might have a planned destination or two. Maybe you're just along for the ride and happy to see new sights.

name: Hustler
text: You've learned how to thrive in the gig economy of a dystopian world like Akiton, Apostae, or Verces. You might be an office worker moonlighting as a delivery driver or odd-job specialist.

name: Icon
text: Everybody wants their 15 minutes of fame, but for you, it's somehow become a lifestyle. Whether by luck or dedication, you're a star performer known across the Pact Worlds.

name: Joro Clone
text: You were an inhabitant of Community Test Vault 341 of Salvation's End, one among hundreds of identical clones of your 'parent,' Joro.

name: Junker
text: Another person's trash is your treasure. You might trawl the Diaspora for salvage or scour the junk heaps of Akiton for useful gear.

name: Laborer
text: You've spent years performing arduous physical labor. It was a difficult life, but you survived. You may have embraced adventuring as an easier way to make a living.

name: Lodge Administrator
text: You know that establishing a lodge takes more than talented field agents—it takes managers, administrators, and a firm knowledge of logistics and politics.

name: Lorespire Archivist
text: You spend your spare time working at the Lorespire Complex as an archivist or educator, perhaps maintaining the Archives' massive collection of texts and artifacts.

name: Lost Aucturnite
text: You once resided on Aucturn, a former planet in the Pact Worlds System that erupted when the Newborn hatched from it.

name: Magic Officer
text: You're a magical adept attached to a military unit, supporting your squad with both spells and shells in equal measure.

name: Magic Scholar
text: You study magic at the Arcanamirium on Absalom Station, one of Dykon's or Pabaq's universities, or somewhere else entirely.

name: Magitech Specialist
text: First Ones sites are known to integrate magitech: a combination of advanced technology and magic, working in synergy to create something utterly alien and powerful.

name: Manifold Recruiter
text: You believe the Starfinder Society is strongest when its members come from diverse backgrounds and societies. You work hard to recruit new members from across the galaxy.

name: Masked
text: You conceal your face with a mask of Embroi, marking yourself as one who congresses with devils. You might have been trapped by a diabolical contract or chosen this path freely.

name: Miner
text: You earned a living wrenching precious minerals from the lightless depths. Adventuring might have seemed lucrative or glamorous compared to this difficult life.

name: Necromancer's Apprentice
text: You apprenticed under a necromancer—a hard education in a field where a cadaver you were dissecting could suddenly animate and every magical artifact hid dark secrets.

name: Outlaw
text: You're a career criminal with a nasty reputation. Perhaps unfair circumstances forced you into a life of crime, or maybe you enjoy the thrill you get from breaking the rules.

name: Party Crasher
text: You were present on Absalom Station when one of the Midwives attempted to drain the station's fabled starstone reactor to ease the birth of the Newborn.

name: Passionate Naturalist
text: Your first love is the myriad organic beings of the natural world, from the simplest single-celled organisms to the most verdant flora and ingenious fauna, and you're determined to see as much of it as you can. To facilitate this passion for biological discovery, you often volunteer to survey alien worlds, perhaps working with Fitch aboard the Starfinder flagship Master of Stars or helping Dr. Heldin Sevaile add entries to his ever-growing Catalog of the Natural World.

name: Phisher
text: You're a fraudster who skillfully creates digital forgeries and manipulates others using the infosphere. You might be a cruel prankster or a cunning criminal.

name: Pickpocket
text: You've learned to spot a tourist a mile away and deftly relieve them of the worldly possessions burdening them—it's better to travel light, after all!

name: Pilgrim
text: Your strong faith drew you to travel to a far-flung destination, perhaps sent on a holy mission by your church or seeking to meditate at a sacred site.

name: Planetary Preservationist
text: You collaborated with the church of Weydan to preserve the ruins on the planet Birnam's Bubble, despite the force shards raining down upon them.

name: Political Activist
text: You're a citizen of Absalom Station and take your civic duty very seriously. You know Absalom Station's government system, politicians, power players, and major organizations like the back of your hand (or similar appendage!), and always strive to keep up with current events and lobby for positive change. You've even met a few members of the governing Syndicsguild in person, including Syndic Arlo Darose and Primex Kantol.

name: Prisoner
text: You've been imprisoned or punished for a crime, whether you were guilty or not. Now that your sentence has ended or you've escaped, you take full advantage of your freedom.

name: Quantum Clone
text: You're a perfect copy of another individual. You were created in a lab accident, or you were spontaneously born from some anomaly. You might share your original's memories.

name: Raised by Belief
text: Whether in a monastery, a religious household, or just as part of your everyday life, your upbringing was steeped in the traditions of a particular faith.

name: Rebel
text: You fought against an interstellar regime on a world like Pulonis or worked to take down the Azlanti Star Empire from the inside.

name: Recluse
text: You used to be someone, but that was in another life. You keep to yourself these days, eking out an existence as a hermit in the wilderness or a reclusive urban dweller.

name: Recruit
text: You're a bright-eyed new recruit. You might be a Steward, an Aeon Guard, a Veskarium imperial trooper, or something else entirely different.

name: Religious Scholar

meta.Skills: religion, deity lore of your choice

text: You're a passionate theologian, with a noted interest in religions and faiths that have been lost, forgotten, fallen out of favor over the passage of time, or endured the death of their god. You joined the Starfinder Society for the chance to study and chronicle these religions, as well as encounter as-yet-unknown ones through your travels.

name: Robot Adversary
text: You recognize the dreaded illumantula from databases the Starfinder Society discovered in Eternity and know without a doubt the danger it—and the station—poses.

name: Runetouched
text: You were born with a strange, rune-shaped birthmark. If you were born in Azlanti Star Empire space, the state church of Lissala marked you for great deeds or terrible fate.

name: Sacrifice
text: You were chosen as a sacrifice. You might be an attendant doomed to die with your Kalistocrat employer on a mausoleum ship, or a victim of a ritual you barely escaped.

name: Salvager
text: You're part of a salvage crew trawling for wrecks in the Diaspora, sailing the mercurial Drift or somewhere out in the Vast looking for profitable derelicts.

name: Saw the Afterlight
text: You died and came back, but your return to life was no miracle, and you didn't glimpse paradise. You were trapped for eons in cold darkness cast in the image of your darkest memories.

name: Scalawag
text: You're a deckhand on a pirate ship hoping to work your way up the ranks to captain someday. You might be a scoundrel with a heart of gold or a pirate through and through.

name: Scaletouched
text: You claim to have a connection to dragons, either real or imagined. You might have grown up with them on Triaxus, or you might have left your home to seek draconic power.

name: Scam Mage
text: You can't cast spells but mimic spellwork well enough to convince others you have magical powers. You've pretended to be a magical adept for so long it's become second nature.

name: Scientist
text: You work in a lab and conduct research about a scientific topic. Perhaps you're a biotechnician, chemist, computer programmer, or theoretical physicist.

name: Shimmerstone Savior
text: You rescued miners on the planet Vesk-8 during an event now known as the 'shattering.' The experience has made you wary of strange magic and mental manipulation.

name: Shipwrecked
text: You were stranded on a remote planet far from your home world with few supplies. You only survived thanks to your survival training, or perhaps just by dumb luck.

name: Showboater
text: You set out to be a famous Starfinder, and to cash in that fame for your own financial benefit. You aim to acquire multiple corporate sponsorships and brand deals, but for now, you're working on seizing every opportunity to be in the spotlight and soaking up the attention.

name: Shrouded
text: You were one of 437 souls inside Riven Shroud when it collided with an alghollthu research station. You died in the collision and were revived by the alghollthus for their own purposes.

name: Simulation Programmer
text: You're a computer programmer who works at the Lorespire Complex, creating holographic and virtual reality training simulations. Often, these training sims are general use, giving agents hands-on experience surveying unexplored planets, handling valuable relics, and engaging in combat without risk. Some are more specific and challenging to create, and are often requested by notable Starfinders, such as Celita, Fitch, Venture-Captain Arvin, Venture-Captain Naiaj, or even First Seeker Sarmak.

name: Skyrigger
text: You're a worker on a massive, floating rig mining precious gases on Bretheda, Liavara, or some other gas giant. You've adapted to working at dizzying heights in dangerous conditions.

name: Smuggler
text: You make your living smuggling cargo, whether on a planet or in the depths of space. You don't ask your clients too many questions, and the cargo pays well enough.

name: Socialite
text: Thanks to generational wealth or lucky circumstance, you live a charmed life flitting between galas dressed in the latest designer fashion.

name: Society Scout
text: As a Starfinder, your motto is explore, report, cooperate! Your goal is to discover and explore new places in distant space, uncover secrets of lost civilizations.

name: Space Pirate
text: You're a crewmate on a pirate vessel with ambitions of pillaging interstellar shipping lanes or taking over a chunk of a notable planetary body.

name: Space Trooper
text: You've deployed or trained on many worlds—low-gravity planets like Pulonis, high-gravity 'crushers' like Vesk-4, and far stranger locales throughout the galaxy.

name: Space Trucker
text: You transport goods across long distances in space. You might be part of a crew on a long-haul freighter, or you might be the captain of your own small hauler.

name: Spacefarer
text: Some people might say you've been out in the Drift too long, but the truth is, you don't feel at home away from your post on a starship deck.

name: Spike Larcenist

meta.Skills: thievery, absalom station lore, underworld lore

text: You grew up deep in the Spike, Absalom Station's underbelly, and while life was sometimes hard and you often broke laws regarding personal property, you grew to love the Spike and its tight-knit communities. Now, you're a Starfinder—you get paid well, you've made friends in high places, and the wealthiest districts and fanciest establishments are open to you. You don't need to pick pockets, shoplift, or plan heists to get by anymore, but old habits die hard! Fortunately, your skills have a wide range of professional applications…

name: Starfinder Hopeful
text: You're a Starfinder megafan turned new recruit who's training at the Lorespire Complex and you're working hard to prepare for your final exam, the Commencement! You grew up watching Starfinder vidshows and playing Starfinder vidgames, you're a faithful subscriber to the Starfinder Chronicles podcast, and you obsessively follow news of the Society's exploits. You consider Starfinders celebrities and hope to meet all your favorites! Choose one: Acrobatics (Steady Balance), Athletics (Combat Climber).

name: Starfinder Snoop
text: Most Starfinders are curious, but you bring this to a whole other level! You constantly put your nose where it doesn't belong, eavesdropping on important meetings, sneaking into restricted areas, and getting your hands on confidential data and documents. The stakes for failing are high, but you believe it's worth the risk!

name: Starfinder Trapsmith
text: You've watched enough vidcasts and played enough vidgames to know that ancient ruins, restricted complexes, and derelict starships have one thing in common—traps.

name: Starship Dweller
text: You grew up on the Idari or another starship and are accustomed to the artificial cycles, tight spaces, and maintenance shifts that have defined your entire existence.

name: Stowaway
text: You snuck onto a ship and traveled a great distance as a stowaway. Your unsuspecting ride might be a battleship with lax security or an unoccupied vessel you commandeered.

name: Street Psychic
text: You're a fortune teller, medium, or folk healer plying your trade in a busy port. Whether your powers are real or performed, clients keep returning.

name: Street Rat
text: You know the streets because they raised you. You grew up scraping by in a massive cityscape like those on Verces or Castrovel, or on a crowded space station.

name: Street Vendor
text: You sell goods at a busy marketplace, such as the Freemarkets of Absalom Station. You've developed a keen eye for spotting deals and scams.

name: Substation Custodian
text: One of your ancestors was a Custodian—one of the countless overlooked engineers who maintain Absalom Station's infrastructure, including the seven substations that funnel power from the Starstone reactor across the station. You once aspired to become a Custodian yourself, perhaps even working as an apprentice Custodian for a time, although in the end you chose to take another path. Fortunately, the skills you learned along the way still serve you well today.

name: Taxi Driver
text: You earn your living transporting people. You know the best shortcuts and scenic routes to any destination in your repertoire, and your passengers arrive on time.

name: Teacher
text: You are incredibly knowledgeable, skilled, and perhaps even trained to teach children and adults about the world and its wonders.

name: Tech Delver
text: You're part of an expedition delving into the ruins of a First Ones city on Aballon, the Wreck of the Returned on Akiton, or some other ancient technological site.

name: Tech Jaded
text: You've seen enough flashing holo-ads and cutting-edge prototypes to last a lifetime. You're trying to avoid detection, or perhaps just live a simpler existence.

name: Tech Priest
text: You commune with the divine through technology. You might be an initiate of Triune's clergy who travels through distant space to perform Drift Beacon rituals.

name: Tech Support
text: Whether working in a military outpost, a deep space exploration vessel, or a local office, you have experience supporting your comrades by assisting with their technology.

name: Tech Troll
text: You enjoy teasing or tricking people using technology. You might be an infosphere trickster or a savvy thief who covers your crimes with digital misdirection.

name: Technophile
text: You love technology. You might be an inventor known for your unique creations, a skilled technician everyone relies on for support, or just an enthusiast with the latest gear.

name: Timelost
text: You're not from this timeline. Somehow you became unstuck in time, or perhaps you attempted temporal travel and ended up trapped somewhen you didn't intend.

name: Tomb Born
text: Your parents conceived you for a fell purpose at a site tainted by death, like a wight's barrow, mass grave, or ossuary. Their reasons could be as varied as the dead themselves.

name: Tourist
text: You've traveled all over the galaxy and have souvenirs to prove it. Navigating crowded streets and alien signage has become second nature to you.

name: Trooper
text: You enlisted in a military or were recruited by a paramilitary group as a career trooper. As long as you've got enough guns and the right squad to back you up, you're ready.

name: Unleashed
text: You've been trapped behind magical wards for as long as you can remember. When the Newborn's cry ripped through space and time, your magical prison was shattered at last.

name: Urban Explorer

meta.Skills: survival, city lore of your choice

text: While some Starfinders are drawn to unexplored alien vistas, traipsing through bug-filled swamps and scaling steep mountain passes, you prefer exploring the urban jungles of the galaxy. Whether it's a pastoral village or a gleaming metropolis, you love to explore its tangled streets, visit its hotspots, forge local connections, and uncover its hidden secrets.

name: Vault Diviner
text: You often spend your time in the Communion Vaults at the Lorespire Complex, performing magical divinations or experiments for the Starfinder Society. Perhaps you train under the enigmatic Starfinder Nykiti Lampadephoros or transcribe the dreams of Whisper of Solar Winds, a slumbering Liavaran Dreamer.

name: Vidgamer
text: Gaming is more than just a hobby for you: it's your way of life. Whether you're a professional player, game designer, hobbyist influencer, or just a dedicated fan.

name: War-Hardened Hero
text: You were present on the planet Kehtaria when the Sihedron Guard attacked, launching the Azlanti-Veskarium war. Through your efforts to maintain peace, you've become a hero.

name: Wayfinder
text: You became a Starfinder because you longed to explore the furthest reaches of the galaxy. You specialize in exploring undiscovered planets and making first contact with alien species.

name: Wheel Winner
text: You were a contestant on Wheel of Monsters, a game show hosted by media mogul Zo! While your fame is temporary, you intend to make the most of your time in the spotlight.

name: Willing Host
text: You speak to spirits only you can perceive: wispy shreds of lost souls, household guardians, ancestral spirits, and other entities. You can negotiate with them to gain their aid.

name: Xenobiologist
text: You're a scientist studying alien life-forms. You adventure just for the opportunity to observe new creatures on other planets.

name: Xenoseeker
text: You seek contact with alien life-forms. You might be a diplomat, researcher, explorer, or proselytizer sharing your beliefs with the galaxy.
